extraction.Name: Paul Lamoureaux
extraction.Recorded patent: patent was recorded December 17, 1918 by Volz Abstract Company
extraction.Buyer: Paul Lamoureaux conveyed the land by deed to Lema Lamoureaux Colburn for $1.00 and other valuable consideration
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612818 issued; Northwest quarter section 17, township 98, north of range 76; receipt for the patent does not appear to have been signed; conveyance dated July 3, 1918
